effects: Sets the signer's wstETH allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20Upgradeable.approve -> _approve(owner=msg.sender, spender, value)).
If value is type(uint256).max, the allowance never goes down when the spender uses it (_spendAllowance skips the decrement).
formats.shown: "Allow to spend 250.5 wstETH", with Spender and Amount fields. Amount shows 'Unlimited' when it is at or above 2^255.

findings.title: approve: the interpolated intent leaves out who gets the allowance.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve interpolatedIntent "Allow to spend {value}". The spender is only in the 'Spender' field. Case 0 shows "Allow to spend 250.5 wstETH" with no party.

findings.title: approve: the Spender addressName types are only 'contract', so an EOA spender may get a type-mismatch warning.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json approve field Spender params.types ["contract"]. ERC20Upgradeable.approve accepts any address.
findings.fix: Allow eoa and wallet types too, or drop the types restriction.

findings.title: approve: the only test case is synthetic, with no mined transaction.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json has txHash null and no mined part.
findings.fix: Add a real BSC approve transaction.

effects: Moves `value` wstETH from the signer to `to` (ERC20Upgradeable.transfer -> _transfer(msg.sender, to, value)). The token has no fees or hooks: WstEthL2Token does not override _update.
formats.shown: "Send 12.34 wstETH to 0x2aeD…1597", with Recipient and Amount fields.

findings.title: transfer: the only test case is synthetic, with no mined transaction.
findings.evidence: cases/1.json has txHash null and no mined part.
findings.fix: Add a real BSC transfer transaction.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value)
effects: Moves `value` wstETH from `from` to `to` (_transfer(from, to, value)).
Uses up `value` of the allowance that `from` gave the signer. It is not decremented if that allowance is max uint (_spendAllowance(from, msg.sender, value)).
formats.shown: "Send 0.1135 wstETH to 0x2aeD…1597", with Sender, Recipient and Amount fields.

findings.title: transferFrom: the interpolated intent leaves out the source account, so it reads as if the signer's own tokens are sent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transferFrom interpolatedIntent "Send {value} to {to}". ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom does _transfer(from, to, value) and _spendAllowance(from, spender, value). In case 2 the signer is 0xE66A…, but the tokens leave 0x08b0…, which appears only in the 'Sender' field.
findings.fix: Use "Send {value} from {from} to {to}" (or "Move {value} from {from} to {to} using your allowance").

findings.title: transferFrom: the only test case is synthetic, with no mined transaction.
findings.evidence: cases/2.json has txHash null and no mined part.
findings.fix: Add a real BSC transferFrom transaction.
